meta.generationModel: two-stage: structural foundation selection, then harmonic color
meta.selectionModel: complete-path beam search — a chord is selected because its PATH won, not because it won its slot locally

context.fingerprintNote: Deterministic hash of the musically relevant project data. Reproducing this run requires the original project file; reference audio is never fingerprinted.

rhythm.continuationModelNote: Slots are opportunities for harmonic change (Phase 4.3B): the structural selector may CONTINUE the sounding foundation — a scored structural action judged on phrase direction, section movement and harmonic-rhythm preferences, position and neighboring anchors — or select a new one. Continued slot runs merge into one sustained event with a single color decision. Cross-phrase sustain stays gated by the intention-driven boundary rule (suspended/ambiguous cadences, continuation/suspension seams, unplanned arrivals); a window-opening continuation after a planned arrival is emitted as a rearticulated event. The material-reuse path maps source material and offers no continuation search option (recorded honestly per slot).
